title: 11. Projects: Memory Management Masterclass
objectives: Build the Memory Management Masterclass projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: array Module & NumPy for Memory Efficiency — CAPSTONE PROJECT: Memory-Efficient Data Processing…
sections.body:
```
BUILD: A production-quality, memory-efficient data processing engine
       that demonstrates ALL 24 concepts.

REQUIREMENTS:

DATA LAYER:
  - Load data from large CSV files using generators (Concept 16)
  - Store numeric columns in numpy arrays (Concept 24)
  - Use __slots__ for row objects (Concept 15)
  - Intern repeated string values (Concept 14)

MEMORY MANAGEMENT:
  - Monitor refcounts for key objects (Concept 08)
  - Detect and prevent circular references (Concepts 09, 10)
  - Use weak references for back-references (Concept 18)
  - Implement object pools using free-list pattern (Concept 13)

CACHING:
  - LRU cache for expensive computations (Concept 20)
  - WeakValueDictionary for result cache (Concept 18)
  - Bounded deque for query history (Concept 20)

PROCESSING:
  - Generator pipeline for streaming processing (Concept 16)
  - Shallow/deep copy when forking processing paths (Concept 17)
  - Memory-mapped temporary storage for large intermediates (Concept 23)

GC MANAGEMENT:
  - Disable GC during batch processing (Concept 11)
  - freeze() long-lived objects at startup (Concept 11)
  - Use gc.collect() between batches (Concept 09)

MONITORING:
  - tracemalloc integration (Concept 21)
  - sys.getsizeof reporting (Concept 22)
  - Refcount debugging hooks (Concept 08)
  - Memory leak detection (Concept 20)

TESTING:
  - Assert no memory leaks after each operation
  - Verify all weak references cleaned up
  - Check gc.garbage is empty
  - Memory regression tests with before/after snapshots

DELIVERABLES:
  1. Core engine: DataEngine class with all features
  2. Demo: Process a 1GB CSV file in < 500MB RAM
  3. Benchmark: compare with naive pandas approach
  4. Memory report: tracemalloc analysis of the engine itself
  5. Leak test suite: 10 tests verifying zero leaks
```
